hints.title: Step Distance Invariance
hints.text: A pattern of length m repeated consecutively means arr[i] must equal arr[i + m] across the repetition.

hints.title: Count Consecutive Matches
hints.text: Iterate i through the array, tracking how many consecutive indices satisfy arr[i] == arr[i + m]. Reset counter to 0 on mismatch.

hints.title: Target Match Length
hints.text: To form k consecutive repetitions of length m, you need (k - 1) * m consecutive matching indices.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking all subsegments takes O(N * m * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single forward pass counting consecutive arr[i] == arr[i + m] runs in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate transforms repeated pattern detection into adjacent stride matching.
complexity.notes: Consecutive repetitions must be contiguous with no gaps.

solutions.approach: Single pass stride match counting (k - 1) * m consecutive matches
